## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / Validation additions

## Checklist

- [ ] All automated validation checks (`python tests/validation/run_all_checks.py`) pass locally
- [ ] Frontend builds without TypeScript errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled exceptions
